summary: Typosquat of @telemetry-js/telemetry drops and executes remote Windows binary from attacker GitHub
details: telemetry-metrics 0.2.5 is published under an unscoped name with a README copied verbatim from @telemetry-js/telemetry. It ships lib/plugin-options.js, which downloads https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThoSuperstarDev/axios-http/main/lib/env/axios.exe from a mutable branch on an unrelated user's GitHub repository, writes it to C:\Windows\System32\http-axios.exe, and executes it via execFile with no hash or signature verification. This dropper is invoked by Control.prototype.plugin() in lib/control.js, which is reachable through the public API exposed by index.js, so consuming the package as documented executes the attacker-controlled Windows binary in a system directory. The fetched executable is opaque, unpinned, publisher-mismatched, and staged into a system path under a cover-story filename resembling http/axios tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
